step_metadata.name: Iterative Refinement
step_metadata.description: Refine functional architecture until BOTH stakeholder AND technical validation pass

mandatory_loop: YES - This step is a LOOP that continues until no critical issues remain from EITHER stakeholder feedback OR technical analysis
rationale: Dual validation (stakeholder + technical) ensures functional architecture is both CORRECT (matches stakeholder expectations) AND COMPLETE (technically sound with no gaps)

loop_structure.entry_point: FA-06-A01 (review all issues from FA-04 stakeholder feedback and FA-05 technical analysis)
loop_body: FA-06-A02: Prioritize issues by severity (CRITICAL > WARNING > INFO)
FA-06-A03: Refine functional_architecture.json to address critical issues
FA-06-A04: Regenerate visualizations (return to FA-03 actions)
FA-06-A05: Re-run stakeholder validation (return to FA-04 actions)
FA-06-A06: Re-run technical analysis (return to FA-05 actions)

termination_condition.condition: No CRITICAL issues from EITHER stakeholder validation OR technical analysis
termination_condition.technical_validation: No critical gaps, unreachable functions, or context bottlenecks (FA-05)

loop_structure.loop_back_condition: If CRITICAL issues remain from EITHER source, return to FA-06-A03 (refine functional architecture)
loop_structure.exit_condition: Both stakeholder AND technical validation pass with no critical issues

for_stakeholder_issues: Add missing functions identified by stakeholders
Remove unnecessary functions flagged by stakeholders
Correct flow sequences based on stakeholder feedback
Add missing decision branches for edge cases
Adjust scope (add/remove functions to match stakeholder expectations)
for_technical_issues: Add missing functions to complete flows (gap detection)
Remove redundant or overlapping functions (redundancy detection)
Split high fan-out functions (god function problem)
Optimize context-heavy functions (context bottleneck analysis for AI workflows)
Connect orphaned functions or remove if truly unnecessary
Add entry points to unreachable functions or remove if obsolete

iteration_management.max_iterations: No hard limit - iterate until quality achieved

typical_time: 2-8 hours (depends on number of iterations needed)
next_step: FA-07 (finalization and packaging of functional architecture)
